lec02-scene-u02.name: 誤判機率來自兩條曲線的重疊

lec02-scene-u03.name: 門檻無法同時減少兩種錯誤；貝氏規則讓誤判最小

lec02-scene-u04.name: 錯誤代價不同時，改為最小化條件風險

lec02-scene-u05.name: 判別函數可任選單調變換，決策不變

lec02-scene-u07.name: 高斯貝氏分類器給出二次決策曲面(QDA)

lec02-scene-u08.name: 共同共變異數會把邊界變成直線（預告）與小結

lec02-scene-u09.name: 課堂練習：只給問題與提示

lec02-root-title.name: lec02-root-title
lec02-root-title.text: **第 2 週：貝氏決策理論與判別函數**

lec02-u01-p0-title.name: p0-title
lec02-u01-p0-title.text: **事後機率由三個概念連起來**

lec02-u01-p0-c1-b.name: p0-c1-b
lec02-u01-p0-c1-b.text: 還沒看資料前，這類的比例。

lec02-u01-p0-c1-e.name: p0-c1-e
lec02-u01-p0-c1-e.text: Prior probability: how often the class occurs before we look at the data.

lec02-u01-p0-c2-b.name: p0-c2-b
lec02-u01-p0-c2-b.text: 假設屬於這類，看到 $\mathbf{x}$ 的可能程度。

lec02-u01-p0-c2-e.name: p0-c2-e
lec02-u01-p0-c2-e.text: Likelihood: if the sample really belongs to this class, how likely we are to see x.

lec02-u01-p0-c3-b.name: p0-c3-b
lec02-u01-p0-c3-b.text: 看到 $\mathbf{x}$ 之後，屬於這類的機率。

lec02-u01-p0-c3-e.name: p0-c3-e
lec02-u01-p0-c3-e.text: Posterior probability: the probability that the sample belongs to this class after we have seen x.

lec02-u01-p0-analogy.name: p0-analogy
lec02-u01-p0-analogy.text: 比喻：醫師看影像，同時看「病常不常見」與「像不像」。

lec02-u01-p0-analogy-e.name: p0-analogy-e
lec02-u01-p0-analogy-e.text: Analogy: when a doctor reads an image, two things matter: how common the disease is in general (prior), and how much the image looks like that disease (likelihood).

lec02-u01-p1-sub-e.name: p1-sub-e
lec02-u01-p1-sub-e.text: Priors: P(ω1)=0.2, P(ω2)=0.8. Likelihoods: p(x|ω1)=0.9, p(x|ω2)=0.3.

lec02-u01-p1-r2-c-cn.name: p1-r2-c-cn
lec02-u01-p1-r2-c-cn.text: 證據 $p(\mathbf{x})$ 是對所有類別加總的總機率。

lec02-u01-p1-r2-c-e.name: p1-r2-c-e
lec02-u01-p1-r2-c-e.text: Evidence: the total probability of seeing x, summed over all classes.

lec02-u01-p2-title.name: p2-title
lec02-u01-p2-title.text: **先驗與證據要一起看，只看一邊會判錯**

lec02-u01-p2-cap.name: p2-cap
lec02-u01-p2-cap.text: 左：先驗與概似；中：乘積；右：除以證據後的事後機率。

lec02-u01-p2-cap-e.name: p2-cap-e
lec02-u01-p2-cap-e.text: Left: prior and likelihood; middle: products; right: posteriors after dividing by the evidence.

lec02-u01-p2-card0-cn.name: p2-card0-cn
lec02-u01-p2-card0-cn.text:
**關鍵觀察**
只看概似選 $\omega_1$，只看先驗選 $\omega_2$，相乘後選 $\omega_2$。

lec02-u01-p2-card0-en.name: p2-card0-en
lec02-u01-p2-card0-en.text: The likelihood alone picks ω1, the prior alone picks ω2, and their product picks ω2.

lec02-u01-p2-card1-cn.name: p2-card1-cn
lec02-u01-p2-card1-cn.text:
**決策規則**
若 $P(\omega_i\mid\mathbf{x})$ 對所有 $j\neq i$ 都最大，就判為 $\omega_i$。

lec02-u01-p2-card1-en.name: p2-card1-en
lec02-u01-p2-card1-en.text: Assign $\mathbf{x}$ to $\omega_i$ if $P(\omega_i\mid\mathbf{x})>P(\omega_j\mid\mathbf{x})$ for every $j\neq i$.

lec02-u01-p2-card2-cn.name: p2-card2-cn
lec02-u01-p2-card2-cn.text:
**記憶要訣**
先乘，再除以總和，最後選最大。

lec02-u01-p2-card2-en.name: p2-card2-en
lec02-u01-p2-card2-en.text: Memory aid: multiply first, divide by the total, then pick the largest.

lec02-u01-p1-denom.name: 分母說明
lec02-u01-p1-denom.text: [補充] 分母 $p(\mathbf{x})$ 對所有類別相同，比較時只要比分子 $p(\mathbf{x}\mid\omega_i)P(\omega_i)$。

lec02-u01-p1-denom-e.name: 分母說明
lec02-u01-p1-denom-e.text: [Added] The denominator $p(\mathbf{x})$ is the same for every class, so compare only the numerators.

lec02-u02-p0-title.name: p0-title
lec02-u02-p0-title.text: **誤判機率是兩塊尾部面積之和**

lec02-u02-p0-intro.name: p0-intro
lec02-u02-p0-intro.text: 兩類先驗相等時，交點 $x_0$ 就是門檻：左邊判為 $\omega_1$，右邊判為 $\omega_2$。概似有重疊，就一定有誤判。

lec02-u02-p0-intro-e.name: p0-intro-e
lec02-u02-p0-intro-e.text: Where the likelihoods overlap, some mistakes are unavoidable. With equal priors, the crossing point x0 is the threshold: left is judged ω1, right is judged ω2.

lec02-u02-p0-f-int.name: p0-f-int
lec02-u02-p0-f-int.text: 積分就是曲線下的面積。

lec02-u02-p0-f-int-e.name: p0-f-int-e
lec02-u02-p0-f-int-e.text: The integrals are areas under the curves.

lec02-u02-p0-t1-b.name: p0-t1-b
lec02-u02-p0-t1-b.text: $\omega_2$ 樣本落在左邊的面積（被判為 $\omega_1$）。

lec02-u02-p0-t1-e.name: p0-t1-e
lec02-u02-p0-t1-e.text: The first term is the area of ω2 samples on the left (wrongly judged ω1).

lec02-u02-p0-t2-b.name: p0-t2-b
lec02-u02-p0-t2-b.text: $\omega_1$ 樣本落在右邊的面積，被判為 $\omega_2$。

lec02-u02-p0-t2-e.name: p0-t2-e
lec02-u02-p0-t2-e.text: The second term is the area of ω1 samples on the right (wrongly judged ω2).

lec02-u02-p1-title.name: p1-title
lec02-u02-p1-title.text: **偏離交點的門檻，誤判都變大**

lec02-u02-p1-phi.name: p1-phi
lec02-u02-p1-phi.text: 其中 $\Phi$ 為標準常態的累積分布函數；$P_e$ 是所有誤判情況的總機率。

lec02-u02-p1-phi-e.name: p1-phi-e
lec02-u02-p1-phi-e.text: Here Φ is the standard normal cumulative distribution function; $P_e$ is the total probability of all mistakes.

lec02-u02-p1-note.name: p1-note
lec02-u02-p1-note.text: 數字由 Python 計算，不是心算；$\Phi(-1)\approx 0.1587$ 是 $-1$ 左側的面積。

lec02-u02-p1-note-e.name: p1-note-e
lec02-u02-p1-note-e.text: Computed with Python, not by hand; Φ(−1)≈0.1587 is the area to the left of −1.

lec02-u02-p2-title.name: p2-title
lec02-u02-p2-title.text: **誤判面積隨門檻移動，交點最小**

lec02-u02-p2-fig.name: p2-fig
lec02-u02-p2-fig.text: 左：兩條加權高斯密度曲線，門檻 0 處有兩塊各為 0.0793 的誤判陰影；右：總誤判機率隨門檻變化的曲線，最低點在 0

image.alt: 左：兩條加權高斯密度曲線，門檻 0 處有兩塊各為 0.0793 的誤判陰影；右：總誤判機率隨門檻變化的曲線，最低點在 0

lec02-u02-p2-cap.name: p2-cap
lec02-u02-p2-cap.text: 左：加權密度 $P(\omega_i)p(x\mid\omega_i)$，兩塊陰影各為 0.0793，合計 $P_e=0.1587$；右：總誤判機率隨門檻變化，最低點在 $x_0=0$。

lec02-u02-p2-cap-e.name: p2-cap-e
lec02-u02-p2-cap-e.text: Left: weighted densities; each shaded region has area 0.0793, and together they give $P_e=0.1587$. Right: total error versus threshold; the lowest point is $x_0=0$.

lec02-u03-p0-title.name: p0-title
lec02-u03-p0-title.text: **門檻無法同時減少兩種錯誤**

lec02-u03-p0-x-h.name: p0-x-h
lec02-u03-p0-x-h.text: **✗ 迷思：同時減少兩種錯誤**

lec02-u03-p0-x-e.name: p0-x-e
lec02-u03-p0-x-e.text: ✗ Myth: moving the threshold can reduce both kinds of error at once.

lec02-u03-p0-o-h.name: p0-o-h
lec02-u03-p0-o-h.text: **✓ 事實：移動一邊，會增加另一邊**

lec02-u03-p0-o-b.name: p0-o-b
lec02-u03-p0-o-b.text: 往某一邊移動，減少一種錯誤，同時增加另一種。

lec02-u03-p0-o-e.name: p0-o-e
lec02-u03-p0-o-e.text: Moving to one side reduces one kind of error and increases the other.

lec02-u03-p0-o-b2.name: p0-o-b2
lec02-u03-p0-o-b2.text: 交點是兩者之和最小的位置。

lec02-u03-p0-o-e2.name: p0-o-e2
lec02-u03-p0-o-e2.text: The crossing point is where their sum is smallest.

lec02-u03-p0-b-h.name: p0-b-h
lec02-u03-p0-b-h.text: **只要兩條曲線重疊，誤判就不可能降到零。**

lec02-u03-p0-b-e.name: p0-b-e
lec02-u03-p0-b-e.text: As long as the two curves overlap, the error cannot be reduced to zero.

lec02-u03-p1-note.name: p1-note
lec02-u03-p1-note.text: 一般情況（任意先驗）下，誤判機率可寫成上式。

lec02-u03-p1-note-e.name: p1-note-e
lec02-u03-p1-note-e.text: In general (for any priors), the error probability can be written as above.

lec02-u03-p1-l-b.name: p1-l-b
lec02-u03-p1-l-b.text: 被減去的積分越大，$P_e$ 越小；把後驗較大的點放進 $R_1$，正是貝氏規則。

lec02-u03-p1-l-e.name: p1-l-e
lec02-u03-p1-l-e.text: To make $P_e$ small, the subtracted integral must be as large as possible. The best choice is to put into $R_1$ exactly the points where $P(\omega_1\mid\mathbf{x})>P(\omega_2\mid\mathbf{x})$. That is the Bayes rule itself.

lec02-u03-p1-r-b.name: p1-r-b
lec02-u03-p1-r-b.text: 每個點歸入事後機率最大的類別。

lec02-u03-p1-r-e.name: p1-r-e
lec02-u03-p1-r-e.text: Multi-class problems work the same way: each point goes to the class with the largest posterior.

lec02-u03-p0-fig.name: 門檻取捨
lec02-u03-p0-fig.text: 兩種誤判隨門檻一增一減,黑線的總誤判在 x0=0 最小 0.1587,x0=±0.5 時為 0.1877（Two error terms trade off as the threshold moves; the total is smallest at x0=0）

image.alt: 兩種誤判隨門檻一增一減,黑線的總誤判在 x0=0 最小 0.1587,x0=±0.5 時為 0.1877（Two error terms trade off as the threshold moves; the total is smallest at x0=0）

lec02-u04-p0-01.name: **誤判的代價不同，要最
lec02-u04-p0-01.text: **誤判的代價不同，要最小化風險**

lec02-u04-p0-02.name: 惡性判成良性，後果遠比反
lec02-u04-p0-02.text: 惡性判成良性，後果遠比反過來嚴重。

lec02-u04-p0-03.name: Calling a ma
lec02-u04-p0-03.text: Calling a malignant tumor benign is far worse than the reverse.

lec02-u04-p0-04.name: $P_e$ 把所有錯誤一
lec02-u04-p0-04.text: $P_e$ 把所有錯誤一視同仁；代價不同時，改為最小化風險。

lec02-u04-p0-05.name: $P_e$ treats
lec02-u04-p0-05.text: $P_e$ treats all mistakes equally; with unequal costs, minimize risk instead.

lec02-u04-p0-08.name: 真實是 $\omega_
lec02-u04-p0-08.text: 真實是 $\omega_k$、卻判成 $\omega_i$ 的代價。

lec02-u04-p0-09.name: The cost of
lec02-u04-p0-09.text: The cost of deciding $\omega_i$ when the true class is $\omega_k$.

lec02-u04-p1-12.name: **條件風險：期望代價最
lec02-u04-p1-12.text: **條件風險：期望代價最小者勝**

lec02-u04-p1-13.name: 對某個 $\mathbf
lec02-u04-p1-13.text: 對某個 $\mathbf{x}$，判成 $\omega_i$ 的期望代價為：

lec02-u04-p1-14.name: For a given
lec02-u04-p1-14.text: For a given $\mathbf{x}$, the expected cost of deciding $\omega_i$ is:

lec02-u04-p1-17.name: 決策規則：選使 $\el
lec02-u04-p1-17.text: 決策規則：選使 $\ell_i(\mathbf{x})$ 最小的 $i$。

lec02-u04-p1-18.name: Decision rul
lec02-u04-p1-18.text: Decision rule: choose the $i$ that makes $\ell_i(\mathbf{x})$ smallest.

lec02-u04-p1-21.name: 最小風險即最大後驗機率，
lec02-u04-p1-21.text: 最小風險即最大後驗機率，也就是貝氏規則。

lec02-u04-p1-22.name: Minimum risk
lec02-u04-p1-22.text: Minimum risk then equals maximum posterior: the Bayes rule.

lec02-u04-p2-45.name: Since $\ell_
lec02-u04-p2-45.text: Since $\ell_1<\ell_2$, decide $\omega_1$, even though the posterior favors $\omega_2$.

lec02-u04-p2-46.name: 系統會更保守，把可疑樣本
lec02-u04-p2-46.text: 系統會更保守，把可疑樣本歸到代價高的那一類。

lec02-u04-p2-47.name: The system i
lec02-u04-p2-47.text: The system is more cautious: doubtful samples go to the costlier class.

lec02-u04-p2-49.name: **要訣**：錯誤有輕重
lec02-u04-p2-49.text: **要訣**：錯誤有輕重，決策要看後果。

lec02-u04-p2-50.name: Mistakes hav
lec02-u04-p2-50.text: Mistakes have different weights; decisions should depend on the consequences.

lec02-u04-p2-fig.name: 後驗與風險
lec02-u04-p2-fig.text: 左圖後驗機率 ω2 較高(0.75 對 0.25),右圖條件風險 ω1 較低(0.75 對 1.25)（Left: the posterior favors omega_2; right: the conditional risk is lower for omega_1）

image.alt: 左圖後驗機率 ω2 較高(0.75 對 0.25),右圖條件風險 ω1 較低(0.75 對 1.25)（Left: the posterior favors omega_2; right: the conditional risk is lower for omega_1）

lec02-u05-p0-02.name: 判別函數 $g_i(\m
lec02-u05-p0-02.text: 判別函數 $g_i(\mathbf{x})$：每一類一個分數，分數最大的類勝出。

lec02-u05-p0-03.name: For each cla
lec02-u05-p0-03.text: For each class define a score $g_i(\mathbf{x})$; the largest score wins.

lec02-u05-p0-05.name: **單調變換**：$f$
lec02-u05-p0-05.text: **單調變換**：$f$ 嚴格遞增，令 $g_i=f(P)$，決策不變。

lec02-u05-p0-06.name: Monotone tra
lec02-u05-p0-06.text: Monotone transform: if $f$ is strictly increasing, decisions stay the same.

lec02-u05-p0-25.name: 分數數值變了，$\ome
lec02-u05-p0-25.text: 分數數值變了，$\omega_2$ 仍然勝出。

lec02-u05-p0-26.name: The numbers
lec02-u05-p0-26.text: The numbers changed, but $\omega_2$ still wins.

lec02-u05-p1-28.name: 決策曲面 $g_{ij}
lec02-u05-p1-28.text: 決策曲面 $g_{ij}(\mathbf{x})=g_i(\mathbf{x})-g_j(\mathbf{x})$，等於 0 處即邊界。

lec02-u05-p1-29.name: The decision
lec02-u05-p1-29.text: The decision surface $g_{ij}$ is zero on the boundary between $\omega_i$ and $\omega_j$.

lec02-u05-p1-35.name: **要訣**：挑一個讓計
lec02-u05-p1-35.text: **要訣**：挑一個讓計算容易的單調函數，決策不會因此改變。

lec02-u05-p1-36.name: Choose a mon
lec02-u05-p1-36.text: Choose a monotone function that simplifies the algebra; decisions stay the same.

lec02-u05-p1-fig.name: 判別差與決策邊界
lec02-u05-p1-fig.text: g(x)=g1(x)-g2(x) 以零點為界:x≈-2.571 與 1.238,中間 g>0 判為 ω1（The discriminant difference with its two zero crossings as decision boundaries）

image.alt: g(x)=g1(x)-g2(x) 以零點為界:x≈-2.571 與 1.238,中間 g>0 判為 ω1（The discriminant difference with its two zero crossings as decision boundaries）

lec02-u05-p0-fig.text: f(p)=√p 曲線上,後驗 0.4286 變成分數 0.6547、0.5714 變成 0.7559,排序不變（On the curve f(p)=sqrt(p), 0.4286 maps to 0.6547 and 0.5714 to 0.7559; the order is unchanged）

lec02-u06-p0-02.name: 高斯分布在樣式識別中很常
lec02-u06-p0-02.text: 高斯分布在樣式識別中很常見。

lec02-u06-p0-03.name: The Gaussian
lec02-u06-p0-03.text: The Gaussian (normal) distribution is common in pattern recognition.

lec02-u06-p0-06.name: 中央極限定理：許多獨立小
lec02-u06-p0-06.text: 中央極限定理：許多獨立小影響加總，常近似高斯。

lec02-u06-p0-07.name: Central limi
lec02-u06-p0-07.text: Central limit theorem: many small independent effects added together often look Gaussian.

lec02-u06-p0-10.name: $\mu$ 定中心位置，
lec02-u06-p0-10.text: $\mu$ 定中心位置，$\sigma^2$ 定寬窄；$\sigma$ 越大，曲線越平寬。

lec02-u06-p0-11.name: $\mu$ sets t
lec02-u06-p0-11.text: $\mu$ sets the center and $\sigma^2$ the width; a larger $\sigma$ gives a flatter, wider curve.

lec02-u06-p1-30.name: the dimensio
lec02-u06-p1-30.text: the dimension of the feature vector

lec02-u06-p1-40.name: 共變異數矩陣，描述各特徵
lec02-u06-p1-40.text: 共變異數矩陣，描述各特徵的散布與相關

lec02-u06-p1-46.name: $\Sigma$ 的行列
lec02-u06-p1-46.text: $\Sigma$ 的行列式，描述散布的大小

lec02-u06-p2-50.name: 對角元素：各特徵自己的散
lec02-u06-p2-50.text: 對角元素：各特徵自己的散布。

lec02-u06-p2-51.name: Diagonal ent
lec02-u06-p2-51.text: Diagonal entries of $\Sigma$: each feature's own variance.

lec02-u06-p2-52.name: 非對角元素：兩兩特徵的關
lec02-u06-p2-52.text: 非對角元素：兩兩特徵的關聯，為 0 代表無線性相關。

lec02-u06-p2-53.name: Off-diagonal
lec02-u06-p2-53.text: Off-diagonal entries: covariances between features; zero means no linear correlation.

lec02-u06-p2-54.name: 等機率線：$\Sigma
lec02-u06-p2-54.text: 等機率線：$\Sigma$ 為單位矩陣的倍數時是圓，否則是橢圓。

lec02-u06-p2-55.name: Equal-probab
lec02-u06-p2-55.text: Equal-probability contours are circles when $\Sigma$ is a multiple of the identity, ellipses otherwise.

lec02-u06-p2-57.name: **記憶要訣：Σ 管形狀
lec02-u06-p2-57.text: **記憶要訣：Σ 管形狀，μ 管位置。**

lec02-u06-p2-58.name: Memory aid:
lec02-u06-p2-58.text: Memory aid: Σ controls the shape, μ controls the location.

lec02-u06-p0-fig.name: 一維高斯
lec02-u06-p0-fig.text: 一維高斯密度曲線,中心在 0(虛線),σ=1;μ 定位置、σ 定寬度（A 1-D Gaussian density: mu sets the centre, sigma the width）

image.alt: 一維高斯密度曲線,中心在 0(虛線),σ=1;μ 定位置、σ 定寬度（A 1-D Gaussian density: mu sets the centre, sigma the width）

lec02-u06-p2-fig.name: 等機率橢圓
lec02-u06-p2-fig.text: 二維高斯的等機率橢圓(示意):軸向與長短由 Σ 決定,中心為 μ（Equal-probability ellipses of a 2-D Gaussian; Sigma sets the shape）

image.alt: 二維高斯的等機率橢圓(示意):軸向與長短由 Σ 決定,中心為 μ（Equal-probability ellipses of a 2-D Gaussian; Sigma sets the shape）

lec02-u07-p0-title.name: p0-title
lec02-u07-p0-title.text: **高斯假設下，判別函數變成二次式**

lec02-u07-p0-zh.name: p0-zh
lec02-u07-p0-zh.text: 把高斯密度代入 $g_i(\mathbf{x})=\ln\bigl(p(\mathbf{x}\mid\omega_i)P(\omega_i)\bigr)$，取對數後指數項變成二次式，去掉對所有類別都相同的常數，得到上式。

lec02-u07-p0-en.name: p0-en
lec02-u07-p0-en.text: Substituting the Gaussian density into $g_i(\mathbf{x})=\ln\bigl(p(\mathbf{x}\mid\omega_i)P(\omega_i)\bigr)$ and taking the logarithm turns the exponential into a quadratic. Dropping the constant that is the same for all classes gives:

lec02-u07-p1-title.name: p1-title
lec02-u07-p1-title.text: **邊界變成二次曲線，這就是 QDA**

lec02-u07-p1-zh.name: p1-zh
lec02-u07-p1-zh.text: **二次決策曲面**：若各類的 $\Sigma_i$ 不同，相減後會留下 $\mathbf{x}$ 的二次項，決策邊界一般是二次曲線：橢圓、拋物線或雙曲線。這種分類器稱為**二次判別分析（QDA）**。

lec02-u07-p1-en.name: p1-en
lec02-u07-p1-en.text: **Quadratic decision surface**: if the $\Sigma_i$ differ between classes, the quadratic terms in $\mathbf{x}$ do not cancel when we subtract the two discriminant functions. The boundary is then generally a conic section: an ellipse, a parabola, or a hyperbola. This classifier is called **QDA (Quadratic Discriminant Analysis)**.

lec02-u07-p2-zh-a.name: p2-zh-a
lec02-u07-p2-zh-a.text: 決策邊界的位置是 $x\approx-2.571$ 與 $x\approx 1.238$，因此 $\omega_1$ 佔據中間區間，$\omega_2$ 佔據兩側。

lec02-u07-p2-en-a.name: p2-en-a
lec02-u07-p2-en-a.text: The decision boundaries are at $x\approx-2.571$ and $x\approx 1.238$. So $\omega_1$ occupies the middle interval $[-2.571,\,1.238]$ and $\omega_2$ occupies both outer parts.

lec02-u07-p2-zh-b.name: p2-zh-b
lec02-u07-p2-zh-b.text: 雖然 $\omega_2$ 的變異數較大，它卻被推到兩側，因為它的寬曲線在遠處的機率反而較大。

lec02-u07-p2-en-b.name: p2-en-b
lec02-u07-p2-en-b.text: Even though $\omega_2$ has the larger variance, it wins on the outside, because its wider curve has more probability far from the center.

lec02-u07-p3-title.name: p3-title
lec02-u07-p3-title.text: **兩條曲線的交點即為兩個邊界**

lec02-u07-fig-qda.name: 圖 lec02-qda-regions
lec02-u07-fig-qda.text: 兩個高斯密度曲線 N(0,1) 與 N(2,2²) 以及其決策區域：兩個邊界位於 x≈-2.571 與 x≈1.238，中間區間著色為 ω1，兩側著色為 ω2

image.alt: 兩個高斯密度曲線 N(0,1) 與 N(2,2²) 以及其決策區域：兩個邊界位於 x≈-2.571 與 x≈1.238，中間區間著色為 ω1，兩側著色為 ω2

lec02-u07-p3-cap-zh.name: p3-cap-zh
lec02-u07-p3-cap-zh.text: 圖說：兩個高斯密度與數字例的決策區域，邊界位於 $x\approx-2.571$ 與 $x\approx1.238$。

lec02-u07-p3-cap-en.name: p3-cap-en
lec02-u07-p3-cap-en.text: The two Gaussian densities and the decision regions of the numerical example. The boundaries are the crossing points of the two curves, at $x\approx-2.571$ and $x\approx1.238$. The middle interval is assigned to $\omega_1$, and the outer parts to $\omega_2$.

lec02-u07-p3-note-zh.name: p3-note-zh
lec02-u07-p3-note-zh.text: **記憶要訣**：兩類寬窄不同，邊界就不再是一個點，而是兩條曲線的交點。

lec02-u07-p3-note-en.name: p3-note-en
lec02-u07-p3-note-en.text: When the two classes have different widths, the boundary is a pair of crossing points, not a single point.

lec02-u08-p0-title.name: p0-title
lec02-u08-p0-title.text: **共同共變異數會讓邊界變成直線**

lec02-u08-p0-zh.name: p0-zh
lec02-u08-p0-zh.text: 若所有類別的共變異數都相同（$\Sigma_i=\Sigma$），判別函數中的二次項在相減時會互相抵消，決策邊界變成直線或超平面。這正是第 3 週線性分類器（如線性判別分析 LDA）的起點。

lec02-u08-p0-en.name: p0-en
lec02-u08-p0-en.text: If all classes share the same covariance ($\Sigma_i=\Sigma$), the quadratic terms cancel when we subtract discriminant functions, and the boundary becomes a line or a hyperplane. This is the starting point of next week's linear classifiers, such as linear discriminant analysis (LDA).

lec02-u08-p1-item0-zh.name: p1-item0-zh
lec02-u08-p1-item0-zh.text: **1.** 貝氏規則結合先驗與概似，算出事後機率，選最大的類別。

lec02-u08-p1-item0-en.name: p1-item0-en
lec02-u08-p1-item0-en.text: The Bayes rule combines priors and likelihoods into posteriors and picks the largest one.

lec02-u08-p1-item1-zh.name: p1-item1-zh
lec02-u08-p1-item1-zh.text: **2.** 概似有重疊，誤判機率就不可能是零；貝氏規則讓它最小。

lec02-u08-p1-item1-en.name: p1-item1-en
lec02-u08-p1-item1-en.text: Whenever likelihoods overlap, the error probability cannot be zero; the Bayes rule makes it as small as possible.

lec02-u08-p1-item2-zh.name: p1-item2-zh
lec02-u08-p1-item2-zh.text: **3.** 錯誤代價不同時，改用條件風險最小化，偏向代價高的類別。

lec02-u08-p1-item2-en.name: p1-item2-en
lec02-u08-p1-item2-en.text: When mistakes have different costs, minimize conditional risk; decisions then favor the costlier class.

lec02-u08-p2-title.name: p2-title
lec02-u08-p2-title.text: **二次式與線性，取決於共變異數**

lec02-u08-p2-item0-zh.name: p2-item0-zh
lec02-u08-p2-item0-zh.text: **4.** 判別函數可以任意選用單調變換，決策不變。

lec02-u08-p2-item0-en.name: p2-item0-en
lec02-u08-p2-item0-en.text: Discriminant functions can use any monotone transform without changing the decision.

lec02-u08-p2-item1-zh.name: p2-item1-zh
lec02-u08-p2-item1-zh.text: **5.** 高斯假設下，判別函數是二次式；共變異數相同時，它會變成線性。

lec02-u08-p2-item1-en.name: p2-item1-en
lec02-u08-p2-item1-en.text: With Gaussian densities the discriminant is quadratic; with a shared covariance it becomes linear.

lec02-u08-p2-close-zh.name: p2-close-zh
lec02-u08-p2-close-zh.text: 共變異數不同則為二次曲線；相同則為直線或超平面。

lec02-u08-p2-close-en.name: p2-close-en
lec02-u08-p2-close-en.text: the quadratic terms cancel when we subtract discriminant functions, and the boundary becomes a line or a hyperplane.

lec02-u08-p0-fig.name: 共同共變異數預告
lec02-u08-p0-fig.text: 共用 Σ 時邊界是單一直線 x1=1;Σ 不同且有非對角項時邊界彎成雙曲線,在水平軸交於 -2.67 與 1.22（Shared Sigma gives one straight boundary; a different covariance with a correlation gives a curved one）

image.alt: 共用 Σ 時邊界是單一直線 x1=1;Σ 不同且有非對角項時邊界彎成雙曲線,在水平軸交於 -2.67 與 1.22（Shared Sigma gives one straight boundary; a different covariance with a correlation gives a curved one）

lec02-u09-p0-q-zh.name: p0-q0-zh
lec02-u09-p0-q-zh.text: **1.** 設 $P(\omega_1)=0.5$、$P(\omega_2)=0.5$，觀察到 $\mathbf{x}$ 時 $p(\mathbf{x}\mid\omega_1)=0.2$、$p(\mathbf{x}\mid\omega_2)=0.6$。求後驗機率並做決策。

lec02-u09-p0-q-en.name: p0-q0-en
lec02-u09-p0-q-en.text: With equal priors, $p(\mathbf{x}\mid\omega_1)=0.2$ and $p(\mathbf{x}\mid\omega_2)=0.6$. Find the posteriors and decide.

lec02-u09-p0-h-en.name: p0-h0-en
lec02-u09-p0-h-en.text: Hint: multiply first, then divide by the total.

lec02-u09-p1-q-zh.name: p0-q1-zh
lec02-u09-p1-q-zh.text: **2.** 在第 3 節的損失矩陣中，若 $\lambda_{21}$ 從 5 改成 2，對同一個點 $P(\omega_1\mid\mathbf{x})=0.25$ 的決策會改變嗎？為什麼？

lec02-u09-p1-q-en.name: p0-q1-en
lec02-u09-p1-q-en.text: In the loss matrix of Section 3, if $\lambda_{21}$ changes from 5 to 2, does the decision for the same point with $P(\omega_1\mid\mathbf{x})=0.25$ change? Why?

lec02-u09-p2-q-zh.name: p0-q2-zh
lec02-u09-p2-q-zh.text: **3.** 當兩類的概似曲線有重疊時，為什麼無論怎麼選門檻，誤判機率都無法降到零？

lec02-u09-p2-q-en.name: p0-q2-en
lec02-u09-p2-q-en.text: When the likelihood curves overlap, why can no threshold reduce the error probability to zero?

lec02-u09-p2-h-zh.name: p0-h2-zh
lec02-u09-p2-h-zh.text: **提示**：想想兩條曲線在重疊區域的面積。

lec02-u09-p2-h-en.name: p0-h2-en
lec02-u09-p2-h-en.text: Hint: think about the area in the overlapping region.
